verdict.rationale: Vue's docs describe it as performant and incrementally adoptable, scaling down to a library ([vue-docs-1], [vue-docs-2]). Community users say it can be dropped in as a single vue.min.js file with no package manager or bundler ([vue-comm-6]) and used on a minimal basis ([vue-comm-4]), which points to a light runtime footprint. There are no concrete bundle-size figures, no tree-shaking documentation and no supply-chain claims; missing for 10: documented bundle size/gzip numbers, tree-shaking or dead-code-elimination evidence, dependency count or supply-chain posture, independent size benchmarks.
